'''TDL-3.5''' was a [[TDL nanny droid]] that was purchased by [[Anakin Solo]]. She tried to replace the "outdated" [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] as caretaker of the Solo children under a code invented by Anakin, "[[Bantha four five six]]." [[Winter Celchu]], who was taking care of the children with C-3PO, recognized that "Bantha four five six" was not the Solo family [[recognition code]] for their [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Upon being dismissed, TDL-3.5 left in a huff.
